sentences.text: type=fact For gold loans, the policy says they are governed by the Bank’s Gold Loan Operational Guidelines read with the Retail Loan Policy, and the RBI directions say that where the specific pre-payment rules do not apply, any pre-payment charge must be as per the approved policy of the UCB and must be clearly disclosed in the sanction letter, loan agreement, and KFS where applicable.

type=fact The evidence does not provide the Bank’s Gold Loan Operational Guidelines or any gold-loan-specific pre-payment charge figure, so a foreclosure charge for the FAQ cannot be confirmed from the record provided.
type=fact The home-loan clauses showing 2% and 3% pre-payment charges relate to a home loan agreement and do not establish the gold loan FAQ charge.

missing.searched: Searched the bank’s gold-loan policy documents and the Retail Loan Policy; only the retail policy reference to gold loans and the RBI disclosure/approved-policy rules were found.
